project.name: Strategy Backtest
project.goal: Find out whether one specific claim about the market survives the data, and write it up either way: 'post-earnings-announcement drift is still tradeable in US large caps after realistic costs.' The deliverable is a reproducible study in the project repo — the hypothesis and falsification test written down before results are looked at, a point-in-time survivorship-free universe, explicit cost and slippage assumptions, in-sample and out-of-sample results reported separately, the number of specifications tried, and a comparison against buy-and-hold and a random-entry control. A null result is a complete deliverable and must be written up with the same care as a positive one. No orders are ever placed; this is research.
